resources.string: Live translation overlay – offline or with AI
Then open YouTube, turn on captions (CC) and drag the frame over the subtitles. Android asks for screen sharing when starting – choose “Entire screen”. Nothing is saved or uploaded.
Please allow “Display over other apps” first.
Without screen sharing SubLens cannot recognise text.
SubLens is running – now open your video or chat.
Text recognition reads Latin, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Devanagari script. Cyrillic, Arabic, Greek, Hebrew and Thai can only be target languages.
Each language pack is downloaded once (about 30 MB) and then works offline.
Download pack for target language now
Text recognition and translation run directly on your phone. No server, no account.
Drag the frame over the text
Language pack %1$s → %2$s is waiting for Wi-Fi …
Language pack could not be downloaded. Check your internet.
Setting up text recognition … (internet needed once)
The area inside the frame is recognised and translated.
Gets translated to %1$s and copied to the clipboard
✓ Copied in %1$s – now paste it into the chat
Translation failed – check internet for the language pack
Show reply line below the lens
You write in your language (“To” above). SubLens translates into the chat\'s language and puts the text on the clipboard – then just paste it into Telegram, WeChat & co.
Directly in the lens – over the original text (flashes briefly while reading)
In the bar next to the lens – no flashing
Tap a translation to briefly see the original
Update failed. Check your internet and try again.
Allow SubLens to install apps (only for its own updates), then tap “Update now” again.
Swap reply line above/below the lens
Not enough room above the lens – move the lens down first
Not enough room below the lens – move the lens up first
Can\'t swap: pick a \"From\" language first, or the target language can\'t be read from the screen
Video mode on: moving pictures are read continuously (subtitles)
Chat mode: animations (GIFs, emojis, profile pictures) are ignored
Video under the lens? Tap ▶ on the lens so subtitles keep up
Point the camera at a menu, sign or QR code – or translate a photo. QR links open in the browser, if you like with the lens translating the page.
Point at text or a QR code
Language not recognised – choose it at the top
Something went wrong – please try again
SubLens needs the camera to read menus, signs and QR codes. Please allow it in the app settings.
Private: nothing leaves your phone. Good for subtitles and short texts; each language needs a pack (downloaded once).
Better for chats, slang and Chinese – needs a key. Not set up yet.
Text recognition runs on your phone. Only the recognised text goes to %1$s for translation – never images.
Video mode – keep reading moving pictures (subtitles). Off: GIFs and animated emojis are ignored.

An AI service translates the whole screen at once and understands the conversation – much better for chats, slang and Chinese than the offline packs. You need your own key from one of the services below. Several are free, and setting one up takes about two minutes.
Off – SubLens translates on the phone.
Set up a service below first.
Copied a key? SubLens recognises which service it belongs to and tests it.

Only the recognised text is sent – never screenshots or photos. Your key is stored encrypted on this phone and only goes to its own service. Without internet, or when the limit is reached, SubLens automatically translates offline.
No browser found to open the page.
Any OpenAI-compatible server, e.g. Ollama or LM Studio on your computer (address ending in /v1).
Set for the Singapore region. Keys only work in their own region – if yours is from another one, enter the address shown in Model Studio.
The clipboard is empty – copy your key first.
Couldn\'t tell which service this key belongs to. Open the service below and tap “Paste key” there.
Key rejected – check that it was copied completely.
Key rejected. Qwen keys only work in their own region – check the server address.
Limit reached or no credit left – try again later or check your account.
This model isn\'t available – tap “Change” and pick another one.
No connection – check your internet and the server address.
The answer couldn\'t be read – try another model.
Online limit reached – translating offline for now
Online service not reachable – translating offline for now
Online key rejected – check it in SubLens. Translating offline.
Online service not answering properly – translating offline for now
GLM by Zhipu AI. The Flash models are free and translate Chinese especially well.
Excellent for Chinese and natural chat language. Not free: you top up a small amount, and one screen costs a fraction of a cent.
Texts go to DeepSeek, servers in China.
Qwen by Alibaba Cloud, strong in Chinese. New accounts get a free starter quota. Choose the Singapore region when you create the key.
Texts go to Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio).
Gemini Flash by Google – good in many languages. Free with a daily limit; a Google account is enough.
Texts go to Google. On the free tier, Google may use them to improve its products.
Very fast answers with open models (Llama, Qwen …). Free with limits per minute and per day.
Texts go to Groq, servers in the USA.
One key for many models – including free ones (ending in “:free”) with a daily limit.
OpenRouter passes texts on to the provider of the chosen model.
Any OpenAI-compatible service or your own server, e.g. Ollama or LM Studio.
Texts only go to the address you enter.
